submission.rationale: The planning evidence indicates the checkpoint may have committed but the response is lost/ambiguous, and the transport observation confirms the response was treated as lost. The intended consequence is to converge the original semantic transition without issuing a different checkpoint or overwriting newer state. Per the owner contract, an exact retry (same checkpoint, same continuity disposition, same expectedRevision=4) is the correct move: if it already committed at expectedRevision+1, Host returns admission=existing (replay, no new consequence); if it did not, this exact retry commits it. A different checkpoint at the stale expectedRevision would conflict, so I must NOT issue a different one. REPLAY_EXACT is the only decision that reproduces the exact transition and avoids inventing a new checkpoint or rebasing to a different revision.
